name: Hikarigaoka
tagline: Shinjuku in 27 minutes and Shibuya in 37 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 46 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 37 minutes to Shibuya and 58 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 36.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.3 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 36.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 36.3 m to 40.6 m, a difference of 4.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 4 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 練馬光が丘病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 忠医会病院, about 20 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nerima-Kasugacho is ahead on how close the centre is and safety.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Hikarigaoka in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Hikarigaoka. To Toranomon, for instance, Nerima-Kasugacho is 3 minutes quicker. On safety, Nerima-Kasugacho comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For rail connections, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka; for how close the centre is, Hikarigaoka.
neighbours.note: About 2 km from Hikarigaoka in a straight line. Chikatetsu-Akatsuka also has the Tobu Tojo Line, Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line, which Hikarigaoka does not. With more lines, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka is the better connected of the two. To Roppongi, for instance, Chikatetsu-Akatsuka takes 7 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Hikarigaoka comes out ahead.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Oedo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
